prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: mypy 2>&1 | tail -40; git ls-files; cat pyproject.toml

cat src/trailhead/geo.py src/trailhead/report.py; grep -rn "heading\|compass\|initial_bearing" src tests README.md | grep -v "^src/trailhead/report.py\|^src/trailhead/geo.py"; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
sed -n 40,75p README.md; grep -n "loop" -ri src tests | grep -v "report.py:3[0-9]"

sed -i 's/^def initial_bearing(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):/def initial_bearing(lat1: float, lon1: float, lat2: float, lon2: float) -> float:/' src/trailhead/geo.py
sed -i 's/^def _heading(track: Track) -> str | None:/def _heading(track: Track) -> str:/; s/^        return None$/        return "loop"/' src/trailhead/report.py
git diff --stat; mypy; ruff check; python -m pytest -q | tail -1
python - <<'E'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src')
from trailhead.track import Track
import inspect; print(inspect.signature(Track))
E
